mission: Make a fresh hosted agent container able to install, prove, and publish from this repo without a workstation: pinned bun, reachable registries, host-aware hooks, and a documented publish handoff where gh, systemd, and 1Password do not exist.
statusNote: Opened 2026-10-01 at the operator's request after the first cloud probe session could not install dependencies (bun 1.3.14 vs pinned 1.4.2; bun.sh and pkg.pr.new denied by the environment's network policy). Accelerator: runs in parallel, takes no lane slot.

provenance.note: Authored directly from a cloud-session probe (research/2026-10-01-container-probe.md); no source exploration. The operator's expiring cloud credits (2026-10-08) are the payback-before-horizon test.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor). Per D4 the cloud session pushes and opens the PR through the GitHub API; the yeet monitor and closeout run operator-side.

phases.name: Research
phases.exit: Container probe recorded as research/2026-10-01-container-probe.md (F1-F14); decisions D1-D7 written into SPEC.md.

phases.name: Toolchain bootstrap
phases.exit: scripts/cloud-session-setup.sh landed in PR #1378: digest-verified bun and tool provisioning, exit-78 preflight, frozen install with retry, full snapshot-package assertion; proven end to end in a cloud container on 2026-10-01.

stopConditions: The environment cannot be configured to allow pkg.pr.new (D2): report with the preflight output; never vendor or mirror the snapshot.

The hook guard would require guessing the host (D3): report instead.
